properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 1 at 2:06PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:
At 206 PM AST, Doppler radar was tracking an area of strong
thunderstorms near Hato Arriba, or near Moca, moving west-northwest
at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph, frequent lightning. Funnel clouds
possible.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
San Sebastian, Moca, Anasco, Las Marias, Aguadilla, Aguada,
Isabela, Lares, Rincon, Hato Arriba, Aceitunas, Luyando, Caban, La
Playa, San Antonio, Maricao, Espino, Mora, Juncal and Rafael
Hernandez.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.
properties.area: Northwest; Western Interior; Mayaguez and Vicinity

properties.description:

* WHERE...Bayamon County in Puerto Rico...
Guaynabo County in Puerto Rico...
San Juan County in Puerto Rico...
Trujillo Alto County in Puerto Rico...

* WHEN...Until 400 PM AST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.

over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.

Carolina.

deaths occur in vehicles.
